The most recent Republican to win a New York governorship was **George Pataki**, who was first elected in the 1994 election.  
On that ballot he appeared under **three party‑lines**:

| Party line on the ballot | Source |
|--------------------------|--------|
| **Republican** | The 1994 “General – Governor” ballot shows Pataki’s name next to the line **Republican**【6†L17-L20】 |

| **Tax Cut Now** | A third ballot line, created specifically for the 1994 race, was the **Tax Cut Now** line, which also carried Pataki’s name. The Tax Cut Now Party was a short‑lived ballot line that ran only for the 1994 election and was later renamed the Freedom Party【7†L39-L53】 |

Thus, when Pataki was first elected governor in 1994, he ran on the ballot lines of the **Republican, Conservative, and Tax Cut Now parties**.
